summary: Independent review of Jinshu 086 units s0421–s0629 against the owned claims. Numbered Jin reign years convert as conventional labels: 太興二年 = AD 319 (晉元帝), 咸和元年 = AD 326 / 八年 = 333 / 九年 = 334 (晉成帝), 永和元年 = AD 345 / 二年 = AD 346 (晉穆帝). Year-only labels are not treated as proleptic-Gregorian month/day dates; December of 咸和八年 or 永和元年 can spill into the next Western year, but no owned event gives a numbered month. 咸和初, 後, 至是, 建興中, 停梁州七年, and the long 永和二年 sequel are correctly one-sided (onOrAfter) and, on living and death rows, unresolved. 劉曜’s killing, 張駿’s death window after 永和元年 and before 永和二年, and 張重華’s 將受詔未及而卒 are not closed from later tradition (AD 329 / 353). Named deaths and sui ages in the owned units are present and not converted to birth years; 同生 is not at issue. Reception of ancient exemplars and posthumous 追諡 / 追崇 is kept off active hints. Eighteen retrospective citation claims reuse 後 or the 永和元年/二年 cluster with the right one-sided Western floor but omit unresolved:true and unresolvedReason, which the matching living host claims already carry.
